model: The shared sheet slid and faded for 500ms on open and 300ms on close. The overlay faded for the default 150ms. Those animations are gone, so the sheet appears in one frame.

noise.rule: 30 is round(500ms * 60 / 1000). 18 is round(300ms * 60 / 1000). 9 is round(150ms * 60 / 1000), the animate-in default when no duration class is set. Not a sampled compositor trace.
